headline: Montevallo unbeaten since Lee beat them in September
dek: Since that defeat Montevallo have dropped points only in two draws, at Delta State in September and at home to Florida Tech in their latest match. North Georgia are the only other side to have beaten them this season, and Nova Southeastern visit next.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring is concentrated at the top: Montevallo alone have more goals than UAH, Spring Hill, AUM, Christian Brothers and West Alabama together.

wire.line: Christian Brothers' one win all season came at King in August, and they finished conference play without a win.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Both matches still past their date with no result are Christian Brothers' matches from August.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lainey Farabaugh has scored 14 goals from 98 shots for Montevallo.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Leslie Azouer has made 104 saves for AUM, at a save percentage of .846.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lee have conceded nine goals across all their matches.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: At least seventeen different players have scored for Lee this season.

last_match.line: Lee had kept a clean sheet against Eckerd; Nova Southeastern were the first side to score on them since UAH.

next_match.line: Nova Southeastern have already held Lee to a draw; Florida Tech ended Montevallo's run of wins.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
